english_research_meaning: Operational log list ordering explicitly elevated scheduled, running and background operations before completed operations; completed rows were expected to display start, end and duration.
defeater_or_limit: Ordering is an operational view preference; a display order proves neither scheduler existence nor clock accuracy.

english_research_meaning: Artifact disclosure proposed linked Scenario/Run/author metadata, open/reveal/copy-path/jump-to-Scenario/open-log shortcuts and collapsed detail until expanded.
defeater_or_limit: Quick actions must be supported by platform capability and resource-specific permission; a path is not a durable artifact receipt.

english_research_meaning: Two right-hand zones were expected to scroll independently so parameters remain usable during inspection of long execution logs.
defeater_or_limit: The original proposed two independent vertical regions; current drawer/tab geometry must be established from implementation, not inferred.

english_research_meaning: Background process cards proposed trigger conditions, last and next execution, latest check outcome and a specific event journal.
defeater_or_limit: Those fields are proposed UX vocabulary, not evidence that any scheduler or trigger executor existed.

english_research_meaning: Floating active-process indicators proposed displaying the initiating user on hover and filtering both Scenario conversation and logs on activation.
defeater_or_limit: Hover-only authorship is not accessible cross-platform; an icon or click does not attest actual active process state.

english_research_meaning: Assignment display proposed active-first ordering, retained completion time and a link to originating Scenario or Artifact.
defeater_or_limit: A local row does not prove delivery, remote ownership, permission or completion acceptance.

english_research_meaning: The file navigator proposed a reverse path from files to the producing Scenario, creation time, initiating author and technical log.
defeater_or_limit: Associating a path to a run requires trustworthy retained origin identity; renamed or externally edited files can break naive lineage.

english_research_meaning: The three settings categories carried concrete examples: appearance/density/filter/notification and remembered form values; workspace/scenario/preset/artifact display; environment/diagnostics/update/log/platform integration.
defeater_or_limit: Grouping and scope of listed preferences were proposal-level; no need, value, implementation or host edit permission established.

english_research_meaning: The environment status view proposed separate indications of workspace availability, active mode, source, readiness, errors, recent launches, logs and results.
defeater_or_limit: A visible node status summary must not flatten source readiness, live process health and recoverable evidence.

english_research_meaning: The early user-facing status vocabulary explicitly distinguished ready, running, waiting, attention required, completed, completed with remarks, error and active background process.
defeater_or_limit: Status labels are proposed translations, not a proven executor state machine; partial effects and observation failure need independent truth.

english_research_meaning: Attention events were proposed across chat/log/rail unread indicators, with short explanation and context actions to inspect log, retry, open folder, diagnose or copy path.
defeater_or_limit: The existence of a retry button must not assert repeatability after unknown effects or permissions; actions are conditional.

english_research_meaning: A specific split was proposed between app-owned operational state/log/cache/runtime storage and user-selected Data-workspace output files.
defeater_or_limit: This is a deployment sketch, not independently verified implementation or an obligation that platform and app stores use one transaction.

english_research_meaning: The original developer-facing sketch argued to use supported external managed-platform functions to their fullest and avoid duplicating those functions in the application.
defeater_or_limit: The anti-duplication rationale survives, but exact responsibility depends on an attested platform version; application-owned business semantics must not be abdicated.

english_research_meaning: The original end-to-end journey began with Explorer visible, selected a Scenario, edited right-side parameters, then displayed a dynamic run card and promoted completed logs and accessible artifacts; a participant or AI could follow the history.
defeater_or_limit: This is not the frozen manifest's actual default scenario-chat launch, nor proof of full cross-user/AI authorized history access.
